node.title: Re: Data::Dumper with unicode
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [bash],

I haven't yet looked at the internals of [doc://Data::Dumper], but on the surface it seems that it does always escape Unicode. Which kind of makes sense to me, because its purpose is to output Perl data in Perl's syntax, which doesn't support Unicode characters in its source, at least not without [doc://utf8]. Which leads me to ask what you're trying to accomplish overall, since there might be a better solution than [doc://Data::Dumper]?

Regards,
-- Hauke D
